trans-unit.source: Invalid time format. Use hh:mm:ss or mm:ss
trans-unit.target: Nepravilna časovna oblika. Uporabite hh:mm:ss ali mm:ss

trans-unit.source: Select an interaction to view details

trans-unit.target: Vnesite video ali zvočni naslov URL

trans-unit.source: Supported services: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify, direct video/audio links
trans-unit.target: Podprte storitve: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify, neposredne video/avdio povezave

trans-unit.source: Are you sure you want to remove the current audio?
trans-unit.target: Ali ste prepričani, da želite odstraniti trenutni zvok?

trans-unit.source: Are you sure you want to remove the current video?
trans-unit.target: Ali ste prepričani, da želite odstraniti trenutni videoposnetek?

trans-unit.source: Also remove all interactions and chapters
trans-unit.target: Odstranite tudi vse interakcije in poglavja

trans-unit.source: Spotify albums and playlists aren't supported. Please use a link to a single track or episode.
trans-unit.target: Albumi in seznami predvajanja na Spotifyju niso podprti. Uporabite povezavo do posamezne skladbe ali epizode.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube link is invalid. Please check the link and try again.
trans-unit.target: Ta povezava do YouTube-a je neveljavna. Preverite povezavo in poskusite znova.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube video doesn't exist or is private.
trans-unit.target: Ta videoposnetek na YouTube ne obstaja ali je zaseben.

trans-unit.source: The owner of this YouTube video doesn't allow it to be embedded. Please use a different video.
trans-unit.target: Lastnik tega videoposnetka na YouTube ne dovoljuje njegovega vgrajevanja. Uporabite drug videoposnetek.

trans-unit.source: YouTube refuses to play this video here because the page doesn't identify itself to YouTube. This happens in WebWriter's preview mode or in documents opened directly from your device. Publish this document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and open it from there.
trans-unit.target: YouTube ne dovoli predvajanja tega videoposnetka na tej strani, ker se stran ne identificira pri YouTube. To se zgodi v načinu predogleda programa WebWriter ali v dokumentih, odprtih neposredno z vaše naprave. Objavite ta dokument na spletnem strežniku (npr. WebWriter Cloud) in ga odprite od tam.

trans-unit.source: The YouTube video could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Videoposnetka na YouTubu ni bilo mogoče naložiti. Preverite povezavo in svojo internetno povezavo, nato poskusite znova.

trans-unit.source: YouTube videos only play on a web server
trans-unit.target: Videoposnetki na YouTubu se predvajajo le na spletnem strežniku

trans-unit.source: YouTube only plays embedded videos on pages that are served by a web server. This is a restriction imposed by YouTube, not by WebWriter.
trans-unit.target: YouTube predvaja vgrajene videoposnetke le na straneh, ki jih gostuje spletni strežnik. To je omejitev, ki jo nalaga YouTube, ne pa WebWriter.

trans-unit.source: As a result, this video will not load in WebWriter's preview mode and in documents opened directly from a device. To let your students watch it, publish the document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and share the link from there.
trans-unit.target: Zato se ta videoposnetek ne bo naložil v načinu predogleda programa WebWriter in v dokumentih, odprtih neposredno z naprave. Če želite, da si ga vaši učenci ogledajo, objavite dokument na spletnem strežniku (npr. WebWriter Cloud) in od tam delite povezavo.

trans-unit.source: If you want to distribute this document as a file rather than through a web server, use a different video source instead of YouTube.
trans-unit.target: Če želite ta dokument razdeliti kot datoteko in ne prek spletnega strežnika, uporabite drug vir videoposnetkov namesto YouTube.

trans-unit.source: Videos from other sources and uploaded video or audio files aren't affected by this.
trans-unit.target: To ne vpliva na videoposnetke iz drugih virov ter naložene video- ali avdio datoteke.

trans-unit.source: No media has been added here yet.
trans-unit.target: Tukaj še ni dodan noben medij.

trans-unit.source: This file could not be read. Please try again or choose a different file.
trans-unit.target: Te datoteke ni bilo mogoče prebrati. Poskusite znova ali izberite drugo datoteko.

trans-unit.source: This file type isn't supported. Please choose an MP4 or WebM video, or an MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC or OGG audio file.
trans-unit.target: Ta vrsta datoteke ni podprta. Izberite video v formatu MP4 ali WebM ali zvočno datoteko v formatu MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC ali OGG.

trans-unit.source: The media player could not be started. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Predvajalnika ni bilo mogoče zagnati. Poskusite znova.

trans-unit.source: This file could not be loaded. It is damaged or isn't a video or audio file.
trans-unit.target: Datoteke ni bilo mogoče naložiti. Je poškodovana ali ni video- ali avdio datoteka.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken or the file may no longer exist.
trans-unit.target: Medijske vsebine ni bilo mogoče naložiti. Povezava je morda neveljavna ali datoteka morda ne obstaja več.

trans-unit.source: This link doesn't point to a video or audio file. Please check the link, or use a link to a supported service.
trans-unit.target: Ta povezava ne vodi do video- ali avdio datoteke. Preverite povezavo ali uporabite povezavo do podprte storitve.

trans-unit.source: Loading the media was aborted. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Nalaganje medijske vsebine je bilo prekinjeno. Poskusite znova.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded because of a network error. Please check your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Medijske vsebine ni bilo mogoče naložiti zaradi napake v omrežju. Preverite svojo internetno povezavo in poskusite znova.

trans-unit.source: The media file is damaged or uses a format your browser cannot play.
trans-unit.target: Datoteka z medijsko vsebino je poškodovana ali je v formatu, ki ga vaš brskalnik ne more predvajati.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken, or the format isn't supported by your browser.
trans-unit.target: Medijske datoteke ni bilo mogoče naložiti. Povezava je morda neveljavna ali pa vaš brskalnik ne podpira tega formata.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Medijske datoteke ni bilo mogoče naložiti. Preverite povezavo in internetno povezavo, nato poskusite znova.

trans-unit.source: The Vimeo video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: Videoposnetka Vimeo ni bilo mogoče naložiti. Morda ne obstaja, je zaseben ali pa vgrajevanje ni dovoljeno.

trans-unit.source: The TikTok video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: Videoposnetka na TikToku ni bilo mogoče naložiti. Morda ne obstaja, je zaseben ali vstavljanje ni dovoljeno.

trans-unit.source: The Spotify track could not be loaded. It may not exist or may not be available in your region.
trans-unit.target: Spotify skladbe ni bilo mogoče naložiti. Morda ne obstaja ali ni na voljo v vaši regiji.

trans-unit.source: The media took too long to load. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Nalaganje medijske vsebine je trajalo predolgo. Preverite povezavo in internetno povezavo, nato poskusite znova.
